GEOGRAPHY — TERMLY EXAM #7
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Energy is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Energy never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Energy.
   C. Treat Energy as rumours only.
   D. Explain Energy with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. Which statement about Earthquakes is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Earthquakes as rumours only.
   B. Explain Earthquakes with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Earthquakes.
   D. Say Earthquakes never happens in Kenya.

3. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

4. Which statement about Folding is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Folding with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Folding.
   C. Treat Folding as rumours only.
   D. Say Folding never happens in Kenya.

5. Which statement about Geographic Information Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Geographic Information Systems as rumours only.
   B. Say Geographic Information Systems never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Geographic Information Systems.
   D. Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. Which statement about Statistical Methods is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Statistical Methods as rumours only.
   B. Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Statistical Methods.
   D. Say Statistical Methods never happens in Kenya.

7. Which statement about Mining is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Mining with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Mining never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Mining as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Mining.

8. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Mombasa
   B. Kisumu
   C. Nairobi
   D. Nakuru

9. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Name the president
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

10. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.
   C. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.

11. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Hide all money underground

12. Which statement about Introduction to Geography is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Introduction to Geography.
   B. Say Introduction to Geography never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Introduction to Geography as rumours only.
   D. Explain Introduction to Geography with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

13. Which statement about Vulcanicity is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Vulcanicity.
   B. Explain Vulcanicity with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Vulcanicity never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Vulcanicity as rumours only.

14. Which statement about Rocks is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Rocks never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Rocks as rumours only.
   C. Explain Rocks with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Rocks.

15. Which statement about Industry is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Industry never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Industry with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Industry as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Industry.

16. Which statement about Agriculture is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Agriculture.
   B. Say Agriculture never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Agriculture as rumours only.
   D. Explain Agriculture with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Energy and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Industry and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Geography and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Map Reading and Interpretation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Statistical Methods and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Geographic Information Systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
